nodes.title: Authentication & sessions
nodes.summary: How a client proves who it is: a password login returns a JWT, and every later request carries it as a Bearer token.

nodes.title: User management
nodes.summary: Creating, registering and updating accounts, and who is allowed to do each.

nodes.title: Data & persistence
nodes.summary: SQLModel tables, the database engine, and the CRUD helpers routes call instead of writing queries inline.

nodes.title: Email & password recovery
nodes.summary: Templated email and the token-based password reset flow.

nodes.title: App wiring & config
nodes.summary: How the FastAPI app is assembled from routers and configured from the environment.

nodes.title: FastAPI application
nodes.summary: app/main.py builds the app, adds CORS for FRONTEND_HOST, and mounts the API router under API_V1_STR (/api/v1).

nodes.title: API router
nodes.summary: app/api/main.py collects the login, users, utils and items routers into one APIRouter.

nodes.title: Route handlers
nodes.summary: The HTTP layer in app/api/routes. Handlers check permissions, call CRUD or security helpers, and shape the response model.

nodes.title: Settings
nodes.summary: A pydantic-settings class in app/core/config.py, loaded once as the module-level settings object.

nodes.title: Dependency layer
nodes.summary: app/api/deps.py provides the per-request database session and the current user, exposed as SessionDep and CurrentUser.

nodes.title: Security core
nodes.summary: app/core/security.py signs access tokens and hashes and verifies passwords.

nodes.title: CRUD layer
nodes.summary: app/crud.py holds the database operations shared by routes and startup code: create, update, look up and authenticate users.

nodes.title: SQLModel models
nodes.summary: app/models.py defines the User and Item tables and the request and response shapes derived from them.

nodes.title: Database engine
nodes.summary: app/core/db.py creates the SQLAlchemy engine from DATABASE_URL and seeds the first superuser.

nodes.title: Email utilities
nodes.summary: app/utils.py renders email templates, sends mail over SMTP, and issues and checks password reset tokens.

nodes.title: JWT access tokens
nodes.summary: Tokens are HS256-signed with SECRET_KEY, carry the user id as sub, and expire after ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.

nodes.title: OAuth2 password flow
nodes.summary: POST /login/access-token takes a username and password form; OAuth2PasswordBearer then reads the Bearer token on protected routes.

nodes.title: Password hashing
nodes.summary: pwdlib hashes with Argon2 and still accepts bcrypt. verify_and_update returns a new hash when the stored one uses an older scheme.

nodes.title: Dependency injection
nodes.summary: FastAPI's Depends resolves the session and current user before a handler runs. Annotated aliases keep handler signatures short.

nodes.title: Session per request
nodes.summary: get_db yields one SQLModel Session inside a with block, so each request gets its own session and it is closed afterwards.

nodes.title: Schema variants
nodes.summary: Each entity has a base class plus Create, Update, table and Public variants, so hashed_password never appears in a response model.

nodes.title: Superuser authorization
nodes.summary: Admin routes depend on get_current_active_superuser. Item routes also allow access when the item's owner_id matches the user.

nodes.title: Configuration from environment
nodes.summary: Settings reads ../.env. A validator refuses "changethis" secrets unless FASTAPI_ENV is development, where it only warns.

nodes.title: Password reset tokens
nodes.summary: A separate JWT with the email as sub, valid for EMAIL_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS (48 by default).

nodes.title: Same cost for unknown emails
nodes.summary: authenticate verifies against a dummy Argon2 hash when the email is unknown, so response time does not reveal which accounts exist. The cost is a full hash on every failed login.

nodes.title: Rehash on successful login
nodes.summary: When verification returns an updated hash, authenticate saves it. Old bcrypt hashes move to Argon2 without a forced password reset.

nodes.title: 8-day tokens, no refresh
nodes.summary: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES defaults to 8 days and the repo has no refresh-token flow. Simple for clients, but a leaked token stays valid until it expires.

nodes.title: Recovery never confirms an email
nodes.summary: recover_password returns the same message whether or not the address is registered, and only sends mail when it is.

nodes.title: Alembic owns the schema
nodes.summary: init_db leaves SQLModel.metadata.create_all commented out. Tables come from Alembic migrations, and init_db only seeds the first superuser.

nodes.title: Private routes in development only
nodes.summary: The private router, which creates users without authentication, is included only when FASTAPI_ENV is development.

nodes.title: Readable OpenAPI operation IDs
nodes.summary: custom_generate_unique_id names each operation tag-name, which gives generated API clients readable method names.

nodes.title: login_access_token
nodes.summary: The login route. Authenticates the form credentials and returns a signed access token.

nodes.title: authenticate
nodes.summary: Looks up the user by email and verifies the password, saving an upgraded hash when one is returned.

nodes.title: verify_password
nodes.summary: Checks a plain password against a stored hash and returns (verified, updated_hash).

nodes.title: get_password_hash
nodes.summary: Hashes a new password with the primary (Argon2) hasher.

nodes.title: create_access_token
nodes.summary: Encodes sub and exp into an HS256 JWT signed with SECRET_KEY.

nodes.title: get_current_user
nodes.summary: Decodes the Bearer token, loads the user, and rejects missing or inactive users.

nodes.title: get_current_active_superuser
nodes.summary: Wraps get_current_user and returns 403 unless the user is a superuser.

nodes.title: get_db
nodes.summary: Yields a database session for the length of one request.

nodes.title: get_user_by_email
nodes.summary: Selects the first user with a matching email.

nodes.title: crud.create_user
nodes.summary: Hashes the password and inserts a new User row.

nodes.title: users.create_user
nodes.summary: Admin route that creates a user and sends a new-account email.

nodes.title: register_user
nodes.summary: Public signup route that creates a user without login.

nodes.title: update_password_me
nodes.summary: Lets the current user change their password after verifying the old one.

nodes.title: init_db
nodes.summary: Creates the first superuser from settings if it does not already exist.

nodes.title: recover_password
nodes.summary: Emails a reset link when the address is registered, and returns the same message either way.

nodes.title: reset_password
nodes.summary: Checks a reset token and sets the new password.

nodes.title: generate_password_reset_token
nodes.summary: Signs a reset JWT for an email address.

nodes.title: verify_password_reset_token
nodes.summary: Decodes a reset token and returns its email, or None if it is invalid.

nodes.title: send_email
nodes.summary: Sends an HTML email through the configured SMTP server.

links.note: Password recovery is part of account security.
The password flow is how a client obtains the JWT.
Authorization is expressed as a dependency, not a check inside each handler.
Decodes and validates the token on each request.
